corrected_claim: Nifty fell about 5% (-~1,200 points) in the week to Dec 20, 2024 - the worst weekly decline in about 2.5 years (steepest since June 2022). However, December 2024 FPI flows were not ~62,000-75,000 crore of net selling; FPIs turned net buyers of about $1.83 billion in Indian equities in Dec-2024, and the record monthly outflow was October 2024 (~Rs 94,000 crore). The ~62-75k crore figure appears to conflate multi-month (Oct-Dec 2024 cumulative ~Rs 1.5 lakh crore) selling with a single month.
